fantasy_02.text: Lantern posts lean above the flooded causeway.

Reflections drift across the water, broken by ripples from the reeds.

fantasy_03.text: Silver dust glints in the grooves left by the last ore cart.

fantasy_04.text: The village falls quiet beneath the bell tower's long shadow.

Weathered steps wind upward past nests of dry straw.

fantasy_05.text: Snowmelt runs through the ruts leading to the tollgate.

The companions draw closer as the road enters the pines.

fantasy_06.text: Wind whistles through the temple roof tiles.

A companion steadies the map with both hands against the gusts.

fantasy_07.text: Reed stalks lean over tracks pressed deep into the river mud.

Waterbirds lift from a patch of reeds farther along the bank.

fantasy_08.text: Crystal light dots the sinkhole walls like an unfamiliar sky.

A companion marks the return passage with a small chalk arrow.

fantasy_09.text: The orchard rows no longer line up with the old royal map.

Leaves rustle overhead although the air below is still.

fantasy_10.text: Feathers cling to the broken hives on the hillside.

A companion steps around a comb glittering with morning dew.

fantasy_11.text: Frost seals the abbey storehouse door around its hinges.

The party's breath clouds the air between the shelves.

fantasy_12.text: Palm shadows fall across stones half buried in sand.
An old caravan cup lies beside the dry edge of the oasis.
Something has disturbed the sand beneath the water jars.

fantasy_13.text: Warm cinders drift over the nursery's dark rock.
Broken shells gleam among the stones near the volcanic vents.
The companions keep to the cooler edge of the passage.

fantasy_14.text: The flagship's rigging hums above the storm-dark deck.

Beyond the rail, the black shoal appears between waves.

fantasy_15.text: The labyrinth stones were laid for strides much longer than theirs.

A companion traces a turn on the map before the next high wall.
